review_note: Reviewed 2026-10-21 from user-supplied native occupations and AO coefficients. CASCI evidence at 2 and 30 angstrom in both bases: source 19-21 span the departing sulfur 3p shell, with four electrons and far occupations 1.33333 each. Source 22 is the CH2SH frontier radical orbital (about 1.0062 far). Select CAS(5,4). Source 18/23 is the largely filled/empty spectator C-S pair (about 1.977/0.027 far). The three sulfur spatial components motivate three doublets and three quartets in the average; only D1 is the reactive parent path. This fragment differs from CH3S, whose two frontier components required the earlier CAS(7,5). These are orbital selections for normal production optimization, not a completed compact-CASSCF or correlated-potential validation. Production performs relaxation and spin splitting; no additional recon calculations are requested.
